title: Steps to Broadway •Sleeps 4 • Pool • Sky Deck
description:
Experience the best of Nashville from this stylish downtown retreat! Just steps from Broadway, you'll walk to live music, top restaurants, the Ryman, Bridgestone Arena, Nissan Stadium, Ascend Amphitheater, and the Country Music Hall of Fame.

Skip the rideshares and enjoy unbeatable convenience, modern comfort, and the perfect home base for concerts, girls' trips, game days, or unforgettable Music City getaways.

STR Permit #2018072157

The space
Stay in the heart of Music City at this stylish vinyl-inspired condo just a short walk from Broadway. Perfect for friend trips, concerts, and Nashville weekends.

✔ Walk to Broadway & Honky Tonks
✔ Music-themed vinyl décor
✔ Private balcony with skyline views
✔ Sleeps 5 comfortably
✔ Smart TV + fast Wi-Fi
✔ Coffee bar
✔ Washer & dryer
✔ Record Player
✔ Neon Signs
✔ Full Length Mirror

Guest access
🔐 **Easy Keyless Entry**

Enjoy smooth, contactless self-check-in with a secure keyless entry system. Your personal code activates at check-in, so you can arrive anytime—no keys, no waiting, no hassle.

Prior to arrival, we will request your email address which will allow you to download and create a login for the DOOR App. Latch will be your virtual key to get access to the unit, amenities, elevators, stairwells, and entrance into the building from street and parking garage.

If you plan to arrive prior to check-in or leave later than your check-out time and need a place to store your baggage, Baggage Bellhop is available onsite 7 days/ week 9AM-5PM.

Other things to note
⭐️ Parking ⭐️

 We have ONE reserved parking space available inside the building for an additional $35/night. 

Extra vehicles can park in guest parking or a nearby parking lot for $35-$50/night (first come, first served and paid daily by parking meter).

**DISCLAIMER 🎸 Nashville doesn’t sleep, and sometimes the streets sing a little louder. Noise levels may vary due to our downtown location. We can’t control it—but we promise it’s part of the vibe!
